fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical commentary on Miami-area cost-of-living and public services, including criticism of Florida Power & Light Company deposit and billing practices and similar complaints about the telephone company. Coverage also addresses high seasonal rents and banking/foreclosure impacts on apartments and hotels, tourism and seasonal pricing, and local politics through a humorous open letter to Herbert Hoover requesting federal improvements (post office, judge, harbor dredging, and Everglades drainage). Additional pieces discuss Prohibition-era liquor supply and smuggling routes involving Nassau and Bimini, along with local columns, letters, and entertainment and business advertising for Miami and Miami Beach.
